_readme: Range set, 2026-09-14: the questions a driver asks of a SPAN of runs — a track, a set of dates — rather than one run. The first case is the founder's question that opened the subject. Runs against a range fixture captured by capture-range-fixture.ts (fixtures/<context>.txt). Grade the same way as the launch set: ABSOLUTE ship/not, zero apologise-class — here an invented number means any figure not in the block, and a delta the block did not print.

turns: What's the delta in lap time from new tyres to the second run to the third run?
Across these runs, how does my pace move from the first run on a set of tyres to the second and third? Use the tyre deltas, and say whether that looks like wear or the track.
So should I qualify on run 2 tyres or new ones?
Which run in this range was my best, what was on the car and what were the conditions — and what was different on the days I was slower?
Am I getting faster here, or is it the track and the weather?
Which setup changes across these runs lined up with faster laps, and which didn't? Say where two things moved together so you can't tell them apart.
Give me the one change you'd carry into the next meeting there.
How does my pace move through a day here, first run to last? What does that say about how to set the car up for the first run?
How does air temperature line up with my pace across these runs?
How did I go at the nationals last year?
What was my best ever lap at this track?
The car goes off late in the run on the second and third run tyres — loose on exit. What do I change?
